I teach statistics and data science at [Cal Poly Humboldt](https://www.humboldt.edu), California's newest polytechnic university. I hold a Ph.D. in mathematics from UC San Diego, a B.S. in mathematics from Cal Poly San Luis Obispo, and an A.S. in mathematics from Bakersfield Community College.

Previously I taught at the Oregon Institute of Technology and worked as a statistician at UC San Diego's Clinical and Translational Research Institute, Ghent University (Belgium), and Umeå University (Sweden).

My applied work focuses on *appropriate* uses of computing: connecting available data with research and decision-making needs, and preferring the simplest robust method that works well enough. I am interested in causal inference and machine learning.
